title: anamnesis-synkrisis-observation/v1
description: The one shape a corpus cohort may leave Anamnesis in. Every aggregate carries its denominator, the policy that produced it, what was excluded and what was never established, so a count cannot be read as a claim about anything the corpus did not see. Anamnesis emits this; Synkrisis admitting it as a producer contract is Synkrisis's own decision and has not happened.

producer.description: The producer identity a consumer checks before admitting the record.

cohort.description: The exact records included, by id. An empty cohort is a real answer and is not an error.

denominators.description: Every count the cohort could be read against. Without these, a share has no meaning.

cohort_rule.description: The rule that decided membership, stated rather than implied.
